Package io.mavlink4j.session

Interface LinkQuality

public interface LinkQuality
Per-link radio-quality telemetry, keyed by LinkId rather than PeerId — a deliberate, separate port from LinkHealth: LinkHealth.Health already collapses to "whichever link this peer was most recently heard on," and folding a per-link RSSI field into it would either go stale the moment a peer is heard on a second link, or force a host's status provider to reason about a dimension it doesn't need. This port answers a different question — "how good is this link right now" — that a future election layer (L3) needs and LinkHealth was never shaped to answer.

of(io.mavlink4j.transport.LinkId) stays link-scoped; the four signing reads are link-and-sender-scoped. RADIO_STATUS is a fact about the radio itself — legitimately one number per LinkId regardless of which vehicle is currently talking over it. A signature, by contrast, belongs to whoever signed it: several vehicles sharing one UDP lobby carrier (one LinkId) must never blend each other's signed/unsigned/rejected counts, so every signing read also takes the sender's SysId.

Thread-safety: Implementations are thread-safe: written from receive threads, read from any thread.

    • of

      Optional<LinkQuality.Quality> of(LinkId id)
      Returns:
      the last known quality for id; empty if no RADIO_STATUS has ever been heard on it

    • signedRecently

      boolean signedRecently(LinkId id, SysId system)
      Returns:
      true if a SignatureStatus.VALID frame from system has arrived on id within the configured window; false once that sender has gone quiet longer than that on this link, or has never produced one at all

    • unsignedFrames

      int unsignedFrames(LinkId id, SysId system)
      Returns:
      how many frames from system on id have carried SignatureStatus.UNSIGNED; 0 for a sender never dispatched to on this link

    • rejectedFrames

      int rejectedFrames(LinkId id, SysId system)
      Returns:
      how many times a frame from system on id has been reported via MavlinkSession#onFrameRejected; 0 for a sender with no rejection yet on this link
